old_description: You probably want to lick your screen. Because whatever you put it on, Jif
about:
The Jif® peanut butter brand, owned by J.M. Smucker Co., has been headquartered in Lexington, Kentucky since its national launch in 1958. The brand debuted with creamy-smooth and crunchy varieties, establishing a presence that has grown over more than six decades.

The company produces a range of peanut butter products including creamy, extra crunchy, natural, reduced-fat, low-sodium (Simply Jif®), and chocolate-flavored spreads, as well as portable formats such as Jif To-Go® cups and squeezable pouches. Manufacturing innovations have included a switch from glass to shatterproof, recyclable plastic jars in 1986 and the adoption of molasses as a sweetener in 1971.

Jif® products are sold primarily through retail grocery channels to consumers. The brand has also engaged in partnerships with organizations such as The Peanut Institute (since 1996), the Boys & Girls Clubs of America (since 2003), and served as a sponsor of the U.S. Olympic Team for the 2014 Winter Olympics.

The brand emphasizes simplified ingredients and taste, promoting 'fewer ingredients' and meeting the FDA standard of 90% peanuts for peanut butter. Its differentiation stems from continuous product innovation—such as the no-utensil squeeze pouch introduced in 2020—and marketing campaigns like the long-running 'Choosy Mothers Choose Jif' slogan.

name: J.M. Smucker Co.
old_description: From mouthwatering fruit spreads and natural peanut butters to dreamy dessert toppings, Smucker's
about:
The J.M. Smucker Co. traces its roots to 1897 in New Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, where Jerome Monroe Smucker pressed cider at his mill and began selling apple butter from a horse-drawn wagon. The business remains under fifth-generation family ownership, with the Smucker family still guiding the company today.

The company manufactures a wide range of food products, including fruit spreads, peanut butters, ice cream toppings, and a portfolio of well-known brands such as Smucker’s, Jif, Folgers, Hostess, Milk-Bone, Meow Mix, and Uncrustables. Production spans natural, organic, low-sugar, and sugar-free varieties, though specific facility sizes and output volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Smucker’s products reach consumers through retail channels across the United States, serving the food and beverage, pet food, and coffee categories. The brand portfolio addresses breakfast, snacking, and pet nutrition markets, with items like natural peanut butters, fruit spreads, snack cakes, coffee, and dog and cat treats.

The company emphasizes its long heritage and a commitment to positive impact on employees, communities, and the planet. Its founding principle — “With a name like Smucker’s, it has to be good” — reflects a focus on product quality that has persisted for over 125 years.

name: J.R.S. Fine Furniture
old_description: Welcome to JRS Fine Furniture. A place to view and shop current pieces large and small along with many pictures of mostly past works and documented processes of the wide world of making things.
about:
J.R.S. Fine Furniture operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where a third-generation craftsman continues a family tradition of making rooted in the Rio Grande Valley. The artisan credits grandparents, mother, and father for early lessons in working with wood and other materials, establishing a practice guided by cultural heritage and the surrounding landscape.

The workshop produces one-of-a-kind furniture pieces including dishes, tables, and integrated planters, each handcrafted from materials such as paduk, cherry, hard rock maple, and ash woods, as well as cement, laminate, and brass accents. A growing catalog of available items is complemented by limited custom commissions, and any piece can be reproduced to order.

The business serves individual clients and design professionals seeking custom furniture and limited-run reproductions, with direct sales through an expanding online catalog and commissioned work arranged on a case-by-case basis.

The maker emphasizes generational skill and the use of only the finest materials, drawing inspiration from New Mexican culture and the natural world to create pieces described as unique works of art built for generations.

name: JA Electronics Manufacturing Co
old_description: cathodic protection solutions custom engineered with up-to-date technology
about:
JA Electronics Manufacturing Co is based in Stafford, Texas. The company provides custom-engineered cathodic protection solutions for the corrosion prevention industry. While its founding year is not publicly stated, its design team has been advising the cathodic protection sector since 1980. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The company manufactures air-cooled cathodic protection rectifiers, custom bond boxes and junction boxes, and solar-powered impressed current cathodic protection (ICCP) systems that pair Kyocera photovoltaic panels with its patented Omega II controller. It also supplies anodes (graphite, high-silicon cast iron, platinum/niobium/mixed-metal oxide coated wire), cables, backfill, and field instruments such as holiday detectors, locators, reference electrodes, and thickness testers. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

JA Electronics serves corrosion engineers, field crews, and companies that operate pipelines, tanks, and other metal structures requiring corrosion control. Its training schools travel across the United States, offering hands-on courses in rectifier installation, design methods, maintenance, troubleshooting, and remote communications. Design consulting services are also available for optimizing cathodic protection systems.

The company highlights its Omega II bridge/controller, which delivers up to 50 amperes with 5% or less output ripple—far lower than the 45% ripple typical of standard units—thanks to fold-back voltage and output regulation. Custom enclosures, mounting options, and the ability to engineer solar-powered systems for sites without commercial power are also cited as differentiators.

name: JANZ Medical Supply
about:
JANZ Medical Supply operates from Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri, and maintains a network of more than 30 locations worldwide. The company focuses on serving active-duty American military personnel, their dependents, veterans, and retirees. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The business distributes durable medical equipment and supplies, including CPAP machines, breast pumps, and lift chairs, sourced from partner brands such as Motif, Cimilre, and Golden Technologies. Beyond product sales, JANZ Medical Supply provides maternity-focused services through its janzmoms.com platform, staffed by certified International Board Certified Lactation Consultants (IBCLCs) and doulas who support hospital, home, and birth-center deliveries.

Primary customers are TRICARE-eligible military families stationed globally. The company ships to APO and FPO addresses and assists with insurance transitions when service members separate from the military and return stateside. It accepts FSA and HSA payments and emphasizes low or zero out-of-pocket costs for many items by verifying eligibility and filing claims on the customer's behalf.

JANZ Medical Supply differentiates itself by combining a worldwide physical footprint with a concierge-style insurance workflow: customers select a product, provide prescription and insurance details, and the company handles eligibility checks, paperwork, and direct shipping, including resupply notifications.

name: JC Barger Custom Wood Furniture
old_description: Looking to upscale your workspace? Explore our Artisan Conference Tables where function meets style, showcased in our Create Gallery.
about:
JC Barger Custom Wood Furniture operates from Kimberly, Idaho, where Josh and Christiana Harshbarger established the family-run business nearly three decades ago. The couple built the company on a passion for craftsmanship and a desire to work closely with family and friends, and they continue to lead the boutique operation today.

The shop produces artisan conference tables and custom furniture pieces, each bench-made using masterful joinery techniques and finished with proprietary in-house blended stains applied by hand. The team offers signature and custom design concepts, creative solutions, and artist renditions, guiding clients from initial sketch through production. As a small team of builders and designers, they handle projects of varying scale but do not disclose facility size or annual volume.

Clients range from homeowners and real estate professionals to restaurant owners and interior designers across the Northwest and beyond. The company regularly delivers to markets such as Sun Valley, Boise, Salt Lake City, Park City, Jackson Hole, and Lake Tahoe, and has shipped as far as Australia. Realtors like Jordan Beard reference the firm for custom installations, while hospitality clients seek durable, distinctive tables that anchor dining spaces.

The Harshbargers position their work as a blend of strength, function, and style that avoids the trade-offs of mass-produced furniture. Their custom finishes are mixed to match any vision, and the collaborative design process ensures each piece reflects the client's unique needs. The result is furniture built to endure, backed by white-glove delivery and a reputation for structural integrity.

name: JD Food

about:
JD Food is a family-owned food distributor headquartered in Fresno, California, in the agricultural heart of Central California. The company has over 60 years of experience in the food industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The distributor supplies a broad range of products including Center-of-the-Plate proteins, cut-to-order USDA meats, fresh produce, dairy, canned goods, frozen seafood, and pantry items. Through an affiliation with Certified Meat Products, JD Food offers custom protein cuts and marinades. Operations run from a state-of-the-art warehouse with cold-chain logistics, supporting an inventory of thousands of SKUs available for next-day delivery.

JD Food serves restaurants, retailers and wholesalers, catering and special-event operators, and healthcare facilities across Central California. The company also sells directly to consumers through an online ordering platform.

The company emphasizes partnership-based service, leveraging buying power from its membership in UNIPRO Food Service Distributors of America to provide competitive pricing. Community involvement includes partnerships with Off the Front, Fresno Mission, and the Marjaree Mason Center.

old_description: Hi – my name is Jacob Dice. I enjoy creating and fabricating. Check out the gallery of projects I have worked on below.
about:
JD Metal Fabrication and Welding operates from Liberty, Missouri, serving the greater Kansas City area. The shop was founded by Jacob Dice, who describes himself as someone who enjoys creating and fabricating. Dice runs the business as a hands-on fabricator, handling projects directly from the shop.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, welding, and CNC plasma cutting for a range of one-off and small-batch work. Core processes include AC/DC TIG welding, machining, CAD design, and mobile welding services. Project examples span entry gates, industrial repair, steel frame and railing fabrication, golf-course and sporting-facility signage, roll cages, fire pits, steel-and-walnut furniture, epoxy table tops, and custom CNC-cut steel parts.

Customers come from industrial maintenance, golf-course and sporting-facility operators, signage contractors, furniture makers, and automotive or racing teams needing roll cages. The shop also serves residential and commercial clients for gates, railings, fire pits, and decorative metalwork in the Liberty and Kansas City region.

The company emphasizes a custom-fit approach built around each client’s space, use, and material requirements, with direct communication from the fabricator doing the work and a focus on local service.

about:
JDM Seattle Engines & Transmissions operates from Tacoma, Washington, under the legal name JDM Seattle Washington Inc. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The business imports and resells Japanese domestic market (JDM) engines, transmissions, wheels, and OEM parts for Toyota, Subaru, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Acura, and Scion vehicles. Its online catalog lists 148 Toyota, 130 Subaru, 84 Honda, 57 Nissan, 17 Mitsubishi, 4 Acura, 3 Mazda, and 2 Scion applications. Each engine is compression-tested before sale, photographed in inventory, and shipped nationwide via freight. Many listings include a 90-day startup warranty on internal moving parts, though some turbocharged units carry a 30-day warranty.

The company serves automotive repair shops, engine rebuilders, and enthusiasts seeking low-mileage replacement powertrains. Customers receive fitment consultation before purchase to verify compatibility with their specific vehicle application.

The operation distinguishes itself with the tagline "JDM Power. Without the Guesswork," emphasizing real-time inventory visibility, pre-sale compression verification, and expert fitment support to reduce the risk typically associated with imported used engines.
